worldcombat.skill.shellsidearm.summary: Press a venomous shell into the firing chamber and launch it, after reading which side of the target is soft: a hard-shell target takes a blunt ram (physical), soft flesh takes a venom spray (special). A hit may poison. You can pin it to the ram (harder, but only at point-blank) or the spray (longer and steadier).
worldcombat.skill.shellsidearm.descripti: On hit the target takes one blow of about %1$s damage, physical or special decided against its soft side (in auto form); the blow grows from whichever of attack and special attack is higher. The attack/special gap %2$s shows whether the individual leans to ram or spray.
Range %1$s, shell speed %2$s, hit radius %3$s; the shell homes in on its locked target.
On hit there is a %1$s chance to poison the target for %2$s; a poisoned target loses health over time, and Poison- and Steel-types are immune.
worldcombat.skill.shellsidearm.form.auto: Auto: range as written; on impact it picks whichever of ram and spray deals more damage.
worldcombat.skill.shellsidearm.form.ram: Ram: forced physical and contact, power x1.05, but range x0.5, shell speed x0.85, +2 windup and +4 cooldown - harder, and only at point-blank.
worldcombat.skill.shellsidearm.form.spra: Spray: forced special, range x1.15 and shell speed x1.15, but power x0.95 - longer and steadier for a little less damage.
worldcombat.skill.shellsidearm.timing: Range %1$s, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.shellsidearm.growth.0: From level %1$s the shell power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.shellsidearm.growth.1: From level %1$s the shell power is %2$s and poison lasts %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.shellsidearm.use.0: Hit an unknown soft side for the most damage
worldcombat.skill.shellsidearm.use.1: A heavy venom shell from long range
worldcombat.skill.shellsidearm.use.2: Switch to the ram for a point-blank burst
worldcombat.skill.shellsidearm.preferenc: Auto picks the harder-hitting side on impact; ram forces physical contact at x1.05 power but halves range and is slower and longer; spray forces special with more range and speed at x0.95 power.
Only within this distance does it consider the target for a shell, then shared approach logic brings the body into range; a larger value starts looking for a position sooner.
When on, low-health targets rank higher so the heavy shell finishes them; when off, all targets rank the same.
When on, targets beyond sixty percent of the range rank higher so the shell is fired from a safer distance; when off, distance does not matter and it is happy to close in.
When on, the companion may leave its post to find a firing position; when off, it only casts at what it can reach from where it stands.
world_combat.move.shellsidearm.text.immu: The foe shrugged off the shell
